verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no bi-directional sync between Trello cards and a code repository's issue tracker such as GitHub or GitLab Issues. The closest item, "View work from Jira in a Trello list," describes a one-way view of a separate tracker, which is an adjacent feature rather than two-way sync. Generic Power-Up marketplace claims, the REST API and webhooks are developer building blocks or unspecified integrations, so they earn no credit.
